questions.subject: GEOMETRY
questions.learningObjective: Classify a pair of angles by their sum
questions.stem: Ticket 101 asks whether two adjacent angles summing to 180 degrees are supplementary. What is the correct classification?

options.text: They are supplementary because their measures sum to 180 degrees.
They are vertical angles because they share a vertex.
options.misconception: mixes vertical angles with adjacent sums

options.text: They are complementary because they add to 90 degrees.
They are congruent because adjacent angles are always equal.

questions.explanation: Angles summing to 180 degrees are supplementary by definition. Adjacent placement does not change the classification, and vertical or congruent labels do not apply here.

questions.subject: GEOMETRY
questions.stem: Ticket 102 shows parallel lines cut by a transversal. Which pair are alternate interior angles?

options.text: The two angles on the same side of the transversal inside the lines.
The two angles on opposite sides of the transversal inside the lines.
The two angles on opposite sides of the transversal outside the lines.
options.misconception: confuses alternate exterior with alternate interior

options.text: The two angles sharing a common side at one intersection.
options.misconception: mistakes adjacent angles for alternate interior

questions.explanation: Alternate interior angles lie between the parallel lines and on opposite sides of the transversal. Same-side interior and exterior pairs are different relationships.
questions.hint: Look between the lines and across the transversal.

questions.subject: GEOMETRY
questions.stem: Ticket 105 states two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. Which statement about corresponding angles is true?

options.text: Corresponding angles are vertical angles in disguise.

Corresponding angles are congruent when lines are parallel.

questions.explanation: When lines are parallel, corresponding angles are congruent. They are not supplementary or complementary by default, and they are not vertical angles.

questions.subject: GEOMETRY
questions.stem: Ticket 106 extends a triangle side. The exterior angle equals which quantity?

The difference of the two non-adjacent interior angles.
The measure of the adjacent interior angle.
The sum of all three interior angles.

questions.explanation: The exterior angle theorem says an exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles. Subtracting or using all three interior angles gives wrong results.
